parsed.post: Discarding the recent run (0.8731). It seems increasing the learning rate or adjusting warmup might have destabilized the model. Reverting to my best (0.8522). Next, I'll focus on tuning MATRIX_LR to find a more aggressive but stable setting for the DEPTH=6, 262k batch configuration.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.07 to see if we can accelerate convergence without losing stability.
